robot: RoboTwin 2.0, dual Franka Panda (RoboTwin franka-panda embodiment, SAPIEN 3), official RoboTwin layouts

robotwin.robot_pose_offset_note: both Franka bases moved 0.10 m toward the table (embodiment robot_pose y -0.65 -> -0.55): with -0.65, RoboTwin layouts reach 0.82-0.86 m from a base, beyond the ~0.80 m top-down reach of the Panda

robot_base_note: robot_base = the primary (right) arm's panda_link0: x forward (toward the far table edge / wall, world +y), y left (world -x), z up; table top at z = -0.01, near table edge at x = 0.20. The left arm's base is at y = +embodiment_dis.
workspace_note: z min -0.05: demo_randomized lowers the table by up to 0.03 m (random_table_height)
dual_arm_note: both arms controllable; the optional `arm` argument (default right) is exposed on the single-arm tools - the model never saw it in training
auto_arm_note: calls without `arm` route by kinematics (motion to a position -> arm whose base is nearer in xy, unless the active arm grips; other arm tools -> active arm; explicit arm wins); the TASK.md intro names the two arms. Left-arm calls see the left wrist camera as robot0_eye_in_hand.
r4_note: harness capabilities used for the RoboTwin 2.0 runs: auto-tilt, grip-on-contact, grasp feedback, auto-relay
r5_note: final RoboTwin configuration: closure-stop gripper hold + compliant hold after a stop (facade fixes), benchmark guide in TASK.md, clear idle arm
